source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("digital ticketing" OR "mobile ticketing" OR "fare integration" OR "contactless payment") AND transit
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("digital ticketing" OR "mobile ticketing" OR "fare integration" OR "contactless payment") AND transit,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("transit" AND ("contactless payment" OR "digital ticketing" OR "fare integration" OR "mobile ticketing"))
